films.desc_en: A slow, cinematic journey through the timeless Macedonian tradition of roasting red peppers in the autumn.
films.music: soulful acoustic guitar, warm cello, gentle percussion, 75 bpm

shots.kf: Wide shot of a misty autumn sunrise over a vast harvested field in the Pelagonia region. A rustic wooden cart sits prominently in the foreground. Soft golden hour light is piercing through the dense fog. Shot on a 35mm lens, cinematic composition, muted earthy color palette, highly detailed, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Dense fog rolls slowly across the harvested field, accompanied by a very slow, cinematic push-in camera movement.

shots.kf: Close-up of large, vibrant red Kapia peppers resting in a woven wicker basket on a wooden table. Rich, deep red tones contrasting with weathered wood. Soft, diffused natural light pouring from a nearby window. 50mm macro lens, shallow depth of field, photorealistic.
shots.motion: A very slow, subtle camera pan from left to right across the textured surface of the vibrant peppers.

shots.kf: Medium shot of a traditional black iron wood stove outdoors, with bright orange flames glowing intensely inside the open door. The setting is a rustic outdoor stone courtyard. Warm, flickering firelight beautifully contrasts with the cool ambient autumn twilight. 85mm lens, moody contrast, rich textures, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Flames flicker and dance wildly inside the iron stove, paired with a slow camera push-in.

shots.kf: Close up of red peppers roasting on the flat metal top of the iron stove. The skin is beautifully blistered and charred black in spots. Wisps of white smoke rise elegantly. Warm golden lighting emphasizes the deep red colors. 85mm macro lens, high detail, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Thick wisps of smoke rise organically from the roasting peppers while the camera remains completely static.

shots.kf: Medium shot of a rustic clay bowl filled with freshly mashed, rich red ajvar spread, sitting on a heavy oak table. A wooden spoon rests inside. Dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, dark background, deep crimson and amber color palette. 50mm lens, highly textured, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Subtle steam rises gently from the warm red spread, captured with a slow circular camera orbit.

shots.kf: Wide shot of a cozy outdoor wooden table set with a glass jar of ajvar, rustic bread, and a traditional ceramic jug, set against a backdrop of a glowing Macedonian sunset over distant mountains. Warm ambient light, inviting atmosphere. 35mm lens, cinematic framing, photorealistic.
shots.motion: A gentle evening breeze subtly rustles the background leaves, accompanied by a slow pull-back camera move.

films.line_en: Your perfect start to the day.
films.desc_en: A high-energy vertical ad capturing the morning crave for traditional flaky pastry and fresh yogurt.
films.music: upbeat modern electronic beat, driving rhythm, 120 bpm

shots.kf: Extreme close-up, vertical framing. A golden, flaky traditional round baked pastry fresh from the oven, resting on a rustic wooden board. Intense, dramatic studio lighting highlighting the incredibly crispy texture and layers. 90mm macro lens, warm golden tones, visually striking, highly detailed, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Visible heat waves and steam burst upwards, while the camera tilts down quickly focusing on the crust.

shots.kf: Medium shot, vertical framing. A continuous thick stream of creamy white fresh yogurt falling into a clear glass. High contrast studio lighting, bright clean whites standing out against a dark slate background. 50mm lens, perfectly centered composition, clean aesthetic, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The thick yogurt pours continuously into the glass in a smooth flow, with a slow camera push-in.

shots.kf: Medium shot, vertical framing. A perfect slice of the golden layered pastry sits on a dark ceramic plate next to a full glass of thick yogurt. Morning sunlight streams through an unseen window, casting dynamic diagonal shadows. 35mm lens, vibrant, appetizing, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Dust motes float gently in the sunbeam, accompanied by a slow dynamic camera orbit around the plate.

films.desc_en: A premium cinematic commercial highlighting the traditional craft of Macedonian white cheese production in a mountain setting.
films.music: Slow, acoustic guitar and gentle strings, rustic and warm, 70 bpm
vo_mk: Од чистите планини до вашиот дом.
Традиција која се чува со генерации.
Мајсторство во секое парче бело сирење.
Вкус кој обединува на секоја трпеза.

shots.kf: Photorealistic wide shot of a 50-year-old man with a thick grey beard, wearing a white linen shirt and a brown leather apron. He stands proudly overlooking a lush green mountain valley in Shar Planina. Morning mist, soft sunrise lighting, cinematic 35mm lens, earthy and green color palette.
shots.motion: Slow drone-like camera push forward. The man's linen shirt softly ripples in the mountain breeze as the morning mist rolls slowly through the valley.

shots.kf: Photorealistic close-up of thick, creamy white milk pouring smoothly into a large, rustic wooden vat. The setting is a traditional stone-walled dairy room. Soft, diffused window light, shallow depth of field, macro lens, monochromatic white and warm wood tones.
shots.motion: Slow camera dolly right. The thick milk continuously pours in a smooth, hypnotic fluid motion, creating gentle ripples in the wooden vat.

shots.kf: Photorealistic medium shot of the same 50-year-old man with a thick grey beard, white linen shirt, and brown leather apron. He is standing in a stone dairy, carefully holding a large, pristine block of white cheese above a wooden brine barrel. Soft top-lighting, cinematic 50mm lens.
shots.motion: Slow camera tilt up. Water droplets continuously fall from the block of cheese as the man holds it perfectly still.

shots.kf: Photorealistic close-up of thick slices of fresh white cheese beside red heirloom tomatoes on a rustic olive-wood board. A drop of golden olive oil sits on the cheese. Warm sunset light filtering through a window, 85mm lens, shallow focus, vibrant red, white, and gold palette.
shots.motion: Slow macro camera push in. The glistening drop of golden olive oil slowly runs down the side of the white cheese slice.

shots.kf: Photorealistic medium portrait of the same 50-year-old man with a thick grey beard, white linen shirt, and brown leather apron. He stands in a dark, atmospheric cheese-aging cellar, holding a wooden platter displaying a perfect block of white cheese. Chiaroscuro lighting, cinematic 50mm lens.
shots.motion: Slow camera dolly backward. The man stands completely still with a subtle expression of pride, while dust motes dance in the cinematic shaft of light.

films.desc_en: A visually rich commercial focusing on the sensory details of baking a perfect, rustic artisanal loaf of bread in a wood-fired oven.
films.music: Warm, emotional piano chords with a subtle upright bass, 80 bpm
vo_mk: Време е за вистински, домашен леб.

shots.kf: Photorealistic close-up of a large, round, artisan rustic loaf of bread with a thick, cracked golden-brown crust. It rests on a rustic wooden table surrounded by raw golden wheat stalks. Warm morning sunlight, cinematic 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, golden and amber color palette.
shots.motion: Slow camera pan around the bread. The wheat stalks subtly sway in a gentle breeze while the bread remains perfectly still in the warm light.

shots.kf: Photorealistic extreme close-up of a smooth, round mound of fresh bread dough on a dark wooden prep table. Fine white flour is mid-air, dusting the surface. Dark, moody bakery background, soft overhead spotlight, macro 100mm lens, high contrast between white flour and dark wood.
shots.motion: Slow-motion effect. The camera slowly pushes forward as the fine white flour particles gently cascade and settle onto the smooth dough surface.

shots.kf: Photorealistic medium shot inside a glowing traditional stone wood-fired oven. The large, round, artisan rustic loaf of bread with a cracked golden-brown crust sits on the hot stone tiles. Soft orange flames flicker in the deep background. Warm, intense firelight, 50mm lens, rich orange and brown tones.
shots.motion: Slow camera dolly right. The orange flames in the background flicker continuously, casting dancing warm light across the crust of the perfectly still bread.

shots.kf: Photorealistic close-up of the large, round artisan loaf, now split perfectly in half, resting on a thick wooden cutting board. Thick, warm steam rises softly from the porous, soft white crumb. Backlit by cool morning window light, 85mm lens, ethereal and warm atmosphere.
shots.motion: Slow camera track forward. Plumes of warm steam continuously rise and drift upwards from the freshly split bread into the morning light.

shots.kf: Photorealistic wide shot of the large, round, artisan rustic loaf with a cracked golden-brown crust, sitting proudly in the center of a table covered with a traditional red-and-black Macedonian embroidered cloth. Sunbeams cross the room. Cinematic 35mm lens, inviting and warm color palette.
shots.motion: Slow camera dolly out. The bread sits still as warm, dusty sunbeams slowly shift angle across the rustic red-and-black traditional tablecloth.
